actions.desktop: left-click the whole microscope to enter the preassembly view.
actions.xr: point the right-hand ray at the whole microscope and press the trigger to enter the preassembly view.
actions.observation: The overall model and viewing angle.

actions.desktop: click the whole model again and wait for the expansion animation.
actions.xr: point the right-hand ray at the whole model and press the trigger again. Wait for expansion to finish.
actions.observation: The structure of the separated components.

actions.desktop: click outside the model to return one assembly level. Free exploration resumes in Normal mode.
actions.xr: point the right-hand ray outside the model and press the trigger to return one assembly level.
actions.observation: Exiting returns one level at a time.

actions.desktop: click a component and read its description on the right. Upper Optical Assembly links to NA; Objective Lens links to spatial frequency.
actions.xr: point the right-hand ray at a component and press the trigger. Read the panel: Upper Optical Assembly links to NA; Objective Lens links to spatial frequency.
actions.observation: Compare the component name, function, and experiment entry.

actions.desktop: click a blank area outside both the description panel and selected component to finish viewing it.
actions.xr: point the right-hand ray outside the selection UI and component, then press the trigger to leave the selection.
actions.observation: Return to the view where other components can be selected.

actions.desktop: click Start Numerical Aperture Experiment and wait for the transition.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select Start Numerical Aperture Experiment, then wait for the transition.
actions.observation: The NA panel appears before you adjust the slider.

actions.desktop: drag the NA slider, changing only NA at a time.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to drag the NA slider, changing only NA at a time.
actions.observation: Compare the half-angle, collection cone, and display changes. Approximate magnification and image changes are teaching mappings; NA is not magnification.

actions.desktop: click Exit and wait to return to the component view.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select Exit and wait to return to the component view.
actions.observation: The Upper Optical Assembly description returns.

actions.desktop: click Start Spatial Frequency Experiment and wait for the transition.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select Start Spatial Frequency Experiment and wait for the transition.
actions.observation: The spatial-frequency panel opens.

actions.desktop: select High.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select High.
actions.observation: This setting is 250 lines/mm. Keep the specimen and illumination fixed; compare the grating, spectrum, and sidebands.

actions.desktop: select Middle.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select Middle.
actions.observation: This setting is 125 lines/mm. Keep the specimen and illumination fixed; compare the grating, spectrum, and sidebands.

actions.desktop: select Low.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select Low.
actions.observation: This setting is 62.5 lines/mm. Keep the specimen and illumination fixed; compare the grating, spectrum, and sidebands.

actions.desktop: select White Light.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select White Light.
actions.observation: Keep frequency and specimen fixed and compare the illustrative illumination feedback.

actions.desktop: select Laser Excitation.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select Laser Excitation.
actions.observation: Keep frequency and specimen fixed and compare the illustrative illumination feedback.

actions.desktop: click Exit and wait to return to the objective component view.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select Exit and wait to return to the objective component view.
actions.observation: The Objective Lens description returns.

actions.desktop: click Begin Operation.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select Begin Operation.
actions.observation: The probe-selection preparation step opens.

actions.desktop: select the Fine probe option.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select the Fine probe option.
actions.observation: The probe description and preview change. The 3x label indicates illustrative relative detail, not objective magnification.

actions.desktop: select the Standard probe option.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select the Standard probe option.
actions.observation: The probe description and preview change. The 2x label indicates illustrative relative detail, not objective magnification.

actions.desktop: select the Robust probe option.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select the Robust probe option.
actions.observation: The probe description and preview change. The 1x label indicates illustrative relative detail, not objective magnification.

actions.desktop: click Install Selected Probe and wait for installation to finish.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select Install Selected Probe, then wait for installation to finish.
actions.observation: The probe moves to its mount. Start System becomes available after installation.

actions.desktop: click Start System.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select Start System.
actions.observation: The automatic principle tour begins after probe installation.

actions.desktop: click Change Probe.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select Change Probe.
actions.observation: The probe-selection view returns.

actions.desktop: click Next.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select Next.
actions.observation: The next tour stage appears, or the next component in Components mode.

actions.desktop: click Previous.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select Previous.
actions.observation: The previous tour stage appears, or the previous component in Components mode.

actions.desktop: click Replay.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select Replay.
actions.observation: The current stage replays, or the current component is shown again in Components mode.

actions.desktop: click the play/pause button.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select the play/pause button.
actions.observation: Pause to inspect details or resume the demonstration.

actions.desktop: click Components / Back to Tour to switch between component descriptions and the principle tour.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select Components / Back to Tour.
actions.observation: In Components mode, select a highlighted component to read its name and function.

actions.desktop: click Exit.
actions.xr: use the right-hand UI ray to select Exit.
actions.observation: The current SNOM session ends and the laboratory view returns.

actions.desktop: left-click to pick up the specimen currently in interaction range.
actions.xr: press the right-hand trigger to pick up the specimen currently in interaction range.
actions.observation: The specimen preview changes. Picking up is distinct from placing it.

actions.desktop: press Z to place the held specimen.
actions.xr: press the left-hand trigger to place the held specimen.
actions.observation: Confirm that the specimen appears on the stage.

actions.desktop: press Z to advance the current observation viewpoint.
actions.xr: press the left-hand trigger to advance the current observation viewpoint.
actions.observation: Wait for the viewpoint change. Another input may be needed to enter observation.

actions.desktop: left-click to remove the specimen from the stage, avoiding SNOM and exploded-model targets.
actions.xr: press the right-hand trigger to remove the stage specimen, keeping the ray away from SNOM and exploded-model targets.
actions.observation: The specimen leaves the stage.

actions.desktop: press B to toggle the light source.
actions.xr: press the right-hand secondaryButton to toggle the light source.
actions.observation: The illumination switches on or off.

actions.desktop: press R to switch objectives.
actions.xr: press the right-hand primaryButton to switch objectives.
actions.observation: The objective position and magnification display change.

actions.desktop: press Tab to switch coarse/fine adjustment. Hold X and use the left/right arrow keys to focus.
actions.xr: press the right thumbstick to switch coarse/fine adjustment. Hold the left-hand primaryButton and move the right thumbstick left/right to focus.
actions.observation: Compare clarity changes. Focusing does not change the objective intrinsic focal length.

actions.desktop: hold X and use the up/down arrow keys to adjust illumination.
actions.xr: hold the left-hand primaryButton and move the right thumbstick up/down to adjust illumination.
actions.observation: Compare brightness changes; they do not establish a change in specimen structure.

actions.desktop: press Z to leave observation.
actions.xr: press the left-hand trigger to leave observation.
actions.observation: The external viewpoint returns.

actions.desktop: left-click the SNOM interaction target to show its entry panel.
actions.xr: point the right-hand ray at the SNOM entry target and press the trigger to show its entry panel.
actions.observation: Confirm that Begin Operation appears.
